content.text: Execute a multi-turn sequence of bash commands.

agent.description: Name of a custom agent defined in ~/.coderex/agents/*.json. Takes precedence over subagent_type. An unknown name is an error that lists the configured names.

subagent_type.description: Built-in agent type (general_purpose, explore, plan, verification, claude_code_guide, statusline_setup), or a configured custom agent name.

writable.description: Whether the sub-agent may write files. false restricts it to read-only tools (Read, Grep, Glob). Defaults to true.

max_retries.description: Shorthand for retry_policy.max_retries when retry_policy is not supplied.

tools.name: Artifact
tools.description: render an HTML file to a web page and read it back

input_schema.description: render an HTML file to a web page and read it back

action.description: what to do; defaults to publish (Artifact), get (ArtifactData), comments (ArtifactComments), verify (ArtifactCheck)

tools.name: ArtifactCheck
tools.description: verify that a published page is intact

input_schema.description: verify that a published page is intact

action.description: what to do; defaults to publish (Artifact), get (ArtifactData), comments (ArtifactComments), verify (ArtifactCheck)

tools.name: ArtifactComments
tools.description: read and reply to comments on a published page

input_schema.description: read and reply to comments on a published page

action.description: what to do; defaults to publish (Artifact), get (ArtifactData), comments (ArtifactComments), verify (ArtifactCheck)

tools.name: ArtifactData
tools.description: read and write a published page's shared database

input_schema.description: read and write a published page's shared database

action.description: what to do; defaults to publish (Artifact), get (ArtifactData), comments (ArtifactComments), verify (ArtifactCheck)

key.description: Config key to query or set

branch.description: Optional branch name for the worktree

glob.description: Only search files matching this glob

server_url.description: MCP server URL to authenticate with

redirect_url.description: The full URL the browser was redirected to after approval. Its code and state are parsed and the state is verified against the pending flow.

code.description: Authorization code, when finishing by hand after the browser callback did not arrive

code_verifier.description: PKCE verifier returned by the earlier call that produced the auth_url (optional when a pending flow is on disk)

headless.description: Return the authorization URL immediately instead of opening a browser. Used by a headless session's re-authorization handler, which prints the URL for a person to open later.

offset.description: Skip this many lines from the start

limit.description: Maximum number of lines to read (default 2000)

args.description: Arguments to pass to the skill

blockedBy.description: Task IDs that must complete first

block.description: Wait for output file to exist

timeout.description: Max seconds to wait for output

query.description: Search query for tool name or description

allowed_domains.description: Only include results from these domains

store.description: which store to list; omit to list every store
which store to write to; personal and project stay on this machine, shared and org are classified before they are sent

key.description: what the memory is about; may be hierarchical ('backend/auth')

if_version.description: the version this write replaces, from memory_read; omit to write regardless
